title: Puzzle stat cards
description: Four white rounded cards in a row, each with a large regular-weight figure and a soft line under it, lifted by a faint violet glow shadow; one card can carry a small info footnote. They fade in and rise ~21px as they scroll into view, one after another. Stacked on phones.
notes: CSS scroll-driven reveal; browsers without view timelines (and reduced motion) show the cards in place
name: puzzle-stats
